force/shock/bloom.name: Hoa nổ
force/shock/bloom.desc: an explosion shaped like a flower: rays rush in, a white flash, then three tiers of petals blast open with a shock ring, embers fly from the petal tips and the petals tear away from the empty centre

force/shock/drill.name: Khoan xoắn
force/shock/drill.desc: a spear of light inside a double helix that screws forward fast; the tip bites off small rings, sparks spiral off, then the coils unwind outward and the tip flies on alone

force/shock/inferno.name: Hỏa xung tầng
force/shock/inferno.desc: a burning punch: rays rush into an orb at the fist, a spiky white flash fuses with a white-hot beam, a dark-red ring stands around the fist, and four tiers of broken calligraphic fire rings fly out with a faint pressure front ahead; the first ring travels farthest and grows widest, every ring cools, fades and breaks into hooks and chips, while bright tracers with arrow heads, sparks and rising embers scatter forward

force/shock/shatter.name: Vòng vỡ
force/shock/shatter.desc: a thick ring slams in, overheats and cracks at eight points (two frames of glowing cracks), then bursts: the arcs tumble outward with hot fracture faces, chips fly from every crack and an energy ring escapes from the middle

force/shock/tiers.name: Tầng vòng
force/shock/tiers.desc: a hot flash at the contact, then three 3D rings born a frame apart along a bright axis streak; they shoot forward accelerating, overshoot, leave motion echoes and shed sparks from their tips

force/shock/vapor.name: Nón hơi
force/shock/vapor.desc: a sonic-boom pressure cone: a hot spearpoint pierces forward while three shells of compressed air peel back from it along flow lines; their mouths curl off into eddies and motes stream back

impact/dash/comet.name: Sao chổi
impact/dash/comet.desc: speed thorns converge from behind into a forward-pointing burst at the contact; slivers keep flying ahead

impact/dash/pierce.name: Xuyên vòng
impact/dash/pierce.desc: a white bulge punches through a standing ring of air while long thorns stream back along the dash like a comet

impact/dash/wall.name: Vách lưỡi liềm
impact/dash/wall.desc: a tall white crescent slams up at the contact, its back edge torn into short curled thorns that trail along the dash; droplets peel off both tips

impact/ground/crater.name: Vòng chấn đất
impact/ground/crater.desc: a spiky ring flat on the ground races out from the impact while a short burst of light stands up in the middle; rocks are thrown to both sides and small dust puffs rise where the ring dies

impact/ground/geyser.name: Phun đất
impact/ground/geyser.desc: a fountain of light thorns shoots straight up from the impact over a low dust skirt, then droplets rain back down while the skirt rolls outward

impact/ground/slam.name: Nện bụi
impact/ground/slam.desc: a fist or weapon slams the floor: light thorns erupt out of a rolling dust bank (a dark back bank and a light front bank, both rolling outward), pebbles arc to both sides, the middle clears first

impact/hit/chevron.name: Mũi chéo
impact/hit/chevron.desc: a directional spray: two wide wings open into a chevron from the contact, thorns and slivers stream away along the hit

impact/hit/cross.name: Chữ thập chí mạng
impact/hit/cross.desc: the critical hit: four long straight pillars in an X, four short curled thorns between them, a thin ring racing out and droplets off the pillar tips

impact/hit/ring.name: Vòng gai
impact/hit/ring.desc: a spiky ring: the core is punched out from the start and keeps widening, its rim stays white-hot while thorns of three sizes spray off the outside

impact/hit/star.name: Nổ sao
impact/hit/star.desc: the classic hit spark: a white-hot core with two long hero thorns, four medium and three nubs curling one way, two straight rays across it, droplets flung from the hero tips
